title: The 2027 ODI World Cup Returns to Africa. Here Is Everything NRIs Need to Know.
excerpt: South Africa, Zimbabwe, and Namibia will co-host the 14-team tournament from October 4 to November 21 — the first men's Cricket World Cup on African soil since 2003. Match timings will be far friendlier for Indian viewers.
body:
The ICC Men's ODI World Cup will return to Africa for the first time in more than two decades.

Dates for the 2027 edition were finalised at the ICC board meeting in Ahmedabad in May, with the tournament set to run from October 4 to November 21, 2027. South Africa, Zimbabwe, and Namibia will co-host — marking the first men's Cricket World Cup on African soil since the 2003 edition in South Africa, Kenya, and Zimbabwe.

## Eight Venues Across South Africa

South Africa will host the bulk of the action, with approximately 44 of 54 matches scheduled across eight venues: The Wanderers Stadium in Johannesburg, Newlands Cricket Ground in Cape Town, SuperSport Park in Centurion, Kingsmead in Durban, St George's Park in Gqeberha, Boland Park in Paarl, Mangaung Oval in Bloemfontein, and Buffalo Park in East London.


![World Cup — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/fb/Kitzbuehel_slalom_ganslernhang_2010.jpg)


Zimbabwe will host eight to ten games across the Harare Sports Club and Queens Sports Club in Bulawayo. Namibia is set to host three matches — with Victoria Falls emerging as a possible venue alongside facilities in Windhoek — in what would be their first time hosting a senior men's Cricket World Cup.

The dates were decided during the ICC's Ahmedabad meeting and are expected to be formally confirmed at the Annual General Meeting in Edinburgh next month.



> **"The dates were decided during the ICC's Ahmedabad meeting and are expected to be formally confirmed at the Annual General Meeting in Edinburgh next month."**


## A Bigger Tournament Returns

The 2027 edition reverts to a 14-team format after the 2023 and 2019 editions featured 10 teams. Teams will be divided into two groups of seven, with the top three from each advancing to a Super Six stage before the semi-finals and final.


![Here Is Everything — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/9/98/Here_Is_Everything_cover.jpg)


South Africa and Zimbabwe qualify automatically as full ICC members and hosts. Namibia, despite co-hosting, must still go through the qualification process — a quirk of the ICC's rules around Associate member nations hosting major events.

## What NRIs Should Know

For the Indian diaspora, the 2027 World Cup presents an unusual travel opportunity. South Africa is home to a significant Indian-origin population — concentrated in Durban, Johannesburg, and Cape Town — dating back to the indentured labour migration of the 1860s. The country's established Indian restaurants, temples, and cultural infrastructure make it a more familiar destination than some previous World Cup hosts.

India's 2003 World Cup campaign, which ended in the final against Australia at the Wanderers in Johannesburg, remains a cherished memory for a generation of fans. The prospect of Indian fans returning to the same venue — now with cheaper direct flights from Mumbai and Delhi to Johannesburg, and a favourable exchange rate — makes this a World Cup many will plan around.


![The Wanderers Stadium — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/18/Wanderers_Stadium_2024.jpg/3840px-Wanderers_Stadium_2024.jpg)


Match timings will be friendlier for Indian viewers than the recent England-hosted events. South Africa is 3.5 hours behind India (IST), meaning afternoon matches in Johannesburg would begin at early evening in India — a significant improvement over the midnight or early-morning starts that plagued the 2019 World Cup in England.

Victoria Falls as a venue adds an extraordinary travel dimension. The possibility of watching a World Cup match and visiting one of the world's great natural wonders on the same trip will not be lost on cricket-loving travellers.

## The Road to 2027

India's preparations for the tournament are already underway. The ongoing ODI series against Afghanistan in Dharamsala — which India won comfortably in the first match on Friday — is part of a longer cycle of 50-over cricket leading to the World Cup. With Rohit Sharma turning 39 and Virat Kohli recovering from a hamstring injury, the next 16 months will determine whether India's senior guard makes one final World Cup run or hands the baton to the next generation.

The qualification pathway for the remaining spots will play out through the Cricket World Cup Qualifier, with Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, West Indies, and Afghanistan among the teams expected to compete for berths.

*Sources: ESPNcricinfo, ICC, SportsTiger, Jagran Josh*
nri_angle: South Africa's large Indian-origin community, favourable time zones for Indian viewers, and the chance to revisit the Wanderers — site of the 2003 final — make the 2027 World Cup a must-plan event for diaspora cricket fans.
